description: This file implements a class for generating and comparing ABI (Application Binary Interface) compatibility reports, including functions for extracting user-defined types, collecting exportables, and diffing elements such as functions, global variables, and symbols. It references other components like IRReader and IRDiffDumper, and contains methods for analyzing ABI differences in a header-checking tool.

classes.name: HeaderAbiDiff
classes.description: A class responsible for generating and comparing ABI compatibility reports, including extracting user-defined types, collecting exportables, and diffing elements such as functions, global variables, and symbols.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::GenerateCompatibilityReport
methods.description: Generates an ABI compatibility report by reading old and new ABI dumps, diffing modules, and dumping the report.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::CompareTUs
methods.description: Compares two translation units (modules) for ABI differences, collecting types, functions, and symbols, and producing a combined status.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::ExtractUserDefinedTypes
methods.description: Extracts user-defined enum and record types from a module.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::CollectUserDefinedTypes
methods.description: Collects user-defined types from old and new modules and compares them.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::CollectUserDefinedTypesInternal
methods.description: Internal template method to collect and compare user-defined types.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::CollectDynsymExportables
methods.description: Collects and diffs dynamic symbol exportables, including ELF symbols.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::Collect
methods.description: Collects added and removed elements (functions, variables, etc.) and their ELF symbols.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::CollectElfSymbols
methods.description: Collects and diffs ELF symbols between old and new sets.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::PopulateElfElements
methods.description: Populates ELF elements into the diff report.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::PopulateRemovedElements
methods.description: Populates removed elements into the diff report.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::PopulateCommonElements
methods.description: Populates common elements and their differences.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::DumpLoneElements
methods.description: Dumps elements that are only present in one set (added or removed).
